notes:
What's new in 0.1.87:
• Many more small fixes found by our own code reviews: podcasts and radio keep the newest search and show you chose, bad podcast feed entries no longer hide good ones, and old radio station details clear when you change station.
• Music and audiobooks: very large lyric timing offsets and bad CUE chapter times are handled safely, and audiobook chapter ends survive extreme speed changes.
• "New" cards expire after seven days, missing artwork is retried when its folder is rescanned, and a failed Watchlist refresh now shows an error you can retry.
• Notification settings keep your unsaved recipient while a test runs, and the webhook test says whether a message was only queued or really delivered.
• Streaming stops waiting for a viewer who has already left, and bad saved playback settings fall back to safe values.
• Built from commit 2a45347cd, Oct 12, 2026, 3:02 AM Eastern.
